name: Toyo Tire Corporation
note: Itami, Hyogo-based tyre maker (TOYO TIRES brand); listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 5105). Per its IR shareholder page (opened 2026-10-01), Mitsubishi Corporation was the largest holder (20.01% as of 2026-06-30) and ceased to qualify as a major shareholder on 2026-08-10.
